  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.</span></h2><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On October 15, 2026, First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. (&#8220;First Tracks Biotherapeutics&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) entered into a securities purchase agreement (the &#8220;Purchase Agreement&#8221;) with certain third party investors (collectively, the &#8220;Investors&#8221;), pursuant to which the Company agreed to issue and sell an aggregate 6,106,870 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock (the &#8220;Common Stock&#8221;), par value $0.001 per share (the &#8220;Offered Securities&#8221;) to the Investors, at a purchase price of $32.75 per share (the &#8220;Private Placement&#8221;). The aggregate gross proceeds to First Tracks Biotherapeutics from the sale of the Offered Securities is expected to be approximately $200 million, before deducting placement agent fees and other offering expenses. The Private Placement is expected to close on October 19, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Purchase Agreement contains customary representations, warranties and agreements by the Company, customary indemnification obligations of the Company to the Investors and other obligations of the parties.</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In connection with the Private Placement, the Company will enter into a registration rights agreement (the &#8220;Registration Rights Agreement&#8221;) with the Investors at the Closing, pursuant to which the Company will be required to file or confidentially submit a registration statement with the SEC covering the resale by the Investors of their shares of Common Stock as promptly as reasonably practicable, and in any event no later than 30 days, following the closing of the Private Placement.</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Neither this Current Report on Form 8-K, nor the exhibits attached hereto, is an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy the securities described herein.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The foregoing descriptions of the Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement do not purport to be complete and are qualified in their entirety by reference to the Purchase Agreement and the Form of Registration Rights Agreement attached as Exhibit B thereto, filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and incorporated herein by reference.</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span Current Report on Form 8-K to provide investors with information regarding its terms. It is not intended to provide any other factual information about First Tracks Biotherapeutics. The representations, warranties and covenants contained in the Purchase Agreement were made only for purposes of that agreement and as of specific dates; were made solely for the benefit of the parties to the Purchase Agreement; may be subject to limitations agreed upon by the contracting parties, including being qualified by confidential disclosures; may not have been intended to be statements of fact, but rather, as a method of allocating contractual risk and governing the contractual rights and relationships between the parties to the Purchase Agreement; and may be subject to standards of materiality applicable to contracting parties that are different from those applicable to investors. Investors should not rely on the representations, warranties and covenants or any descriptions thereof as characterizations of the actual state of facts or condition of First Tracks Biotherapeutics. Moreover, information concerning the subject matter of the representations, warranties and covenants may change after the date of the Purchase Agreement, which subsequent information may or may not be fully reflected in First Tracks Biotherapeutics&#8217; public disclosures.</span></p><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New
